items.name: Deildegast
items.lore: A spirit drawn from tales of those who disturbed boundary stones, doomed to fixate on things that have been moved from their place.
items.hiddenAbility: Counts distinct objects moved outside hunts; the accumulated disruption reduces its speed on subsequent hunts, up to a limit.
items.movementSpeed: Starts near 3.0 m/s and becomes progressively slower as distinct objects are moved between hunts.
strengths: Has a major speed advantage at the start of an investigation
Early hunts can approach Revenant chase speed
weaknesses: Living and dead players can slow it by moving distinct objects outside hunts
tips: Compare an early hunt with later hunts after moving many unique props
Move distinct objects before the next hunt; moving an item during a hunt does not immediately slow it
misconceptions: The official name is Deildegast, not Dildegeist
Repeatedly moving the same object does not stack the slowdown

items.name: Aswang
items.lore: A predatory spirit that becomes increasingly dangerous once it finds its prey.
items.hiddenAbility: May begin a hunt with no apparent grace period.
items.movementSpeed: Lower base speed with strong line-of-sight acceleration.
weaknesses: Hidden targets may survive its attack
tips: Compare grace time and line-of-sight acceleration across hunts
misconceptions: A short grace period alone is not conclusive

items.name: Banshee
items.lore: A singing hunter that fixates on a single investigator.
items.hiddenAbility: Targets one player while that player is in the building.
tips: Track who is chased and listen with a parabolic microphone
misconceptions: Singing events alone do not prove Banshee

items.name: Dayan
items.lore: A restless ghost whose pace mirrors nearby movement.
items.hiddenAbility: Changes speed based on whether a nearby player moves.
items.movementSpeed: Fast near moving players; slow near still players.
tips: Test movement at a safe looping location
misconceptions: Normal line-of-sight acceleration can resemble its tell

items.name: Demon
items.lore: An aggressive ghost known for early and frequent hunts.
items.hiddenAbility: Can initiate a hunt at any sanity.
tips: Time incense protection and test crucifix range
misconceptions: One early hunt is not enough to confirm Demon

items.name: Deogen
items.lore: An all-seeing ghost that always knows where investigators hide.
items.hiddenAbility: Rare heavy-breathing Spirit Box response.
items.movementSpeed: Very fast at range; extremely slow nearby.
weaknesses: Can be easily looped at close range
tips: Do not hide; keep a looping route open
misconceptions: Fast footsteps at range do not mean Revenant

items.name: Gallu
items.lore: A volatile spirit that shifts between weakened and enraged states.
items.hiddenAbility: Crucifix interactions can alter its state.
weaknesses: Can be forced into a weakened state
tips: Track salt and crucifix interactions between hunts
misconceptions: Inconsistent speed alone is not proof

items.name: Goryo
items.lore: A territorial ghost reluctant to leave its chosen room.
items.hiddenAbility: D.O.T.S is visible only through a video camera when nobody is nearby.
tips: Watch D.O.T.S remotely from outside the room
misconceptions: Lack of visible D.O.T.S is not immediate proof

items.name: Hantu
items.lore: A cold-weather ghost whose speed follows temperature.
items.hiddenAbility: Shows freezing breath during hunts when the breaker is off.
items.movementSpeed: Faster in colder rooms; slower in warm rooms.
tips: Compare speed across rooms with the breaker state controlled
misconceptions: Any visible breath is not automatically Hantu

items.name: Jinn
items.lore: An electrical ghost empowered by a working fuse box.
items.hiddenAbility: Can drain nearby sanity at the fuse box.
items.movementSpeed: Fast at distance with breaker on and line of sight.
weaknesses: Cannot directly turn off the fuse box
tips: Test speed with breaker on, then observe fuse-box EMF
misconceptions: A tripped breaker from too many lights does not rule out Jinn

items.name: Kormos
items.lore: A blind pursuer that hunts by sound and disturbance.
items.hiddenAbility: Detects voice, electronics, and footsteps rather than sight.
items.huntThreshold: Raised by sprinting in its room
strengths: Tracks noisy investigators without line of sight
tips: Test line-of-sight and sound separately
misconceptions: Ignoring a visible player once is not conclusive

items.name: Mare
items.lore: A creature of darkness that is more dangerous without light.
items.hiddenAbility: May immediately switch off a light that a player turns on.
tips: Control room lighting and watch for the instant switch tell
misconceptions: Frequently turning lights off is not unique

items.name: Moroi
items.lore: A cursed spirit that grows faster as team sanity falls.
items.hiddenAbility: Paranormal audio can curse an investigator with increased sanity drain.
tips: Use sanity medication to test the curse and speed
misconceptions: A fast late-game ghost is not automatically Moroi

items.name: Myling
items.lore: A quiet hunter that masks its footsteps until it is close.
items.hiddenAbility: Produces paranormal sounds more often.
weaknesses: Electronic interference begins before footsteps become audible
tips: Drop a flashlight and compare interference to footsteps
misconceptions: Volume varies by floor and obstruction

items.name: Obake
items.lore: A shapeshifter that leaves unusual biological traces.
items.hiddenAbility: Can briefly change model during a hunt.
tips: Check every UV interaction and watch hunt blinks
misconceptions: A missing print on one interaction is not definitive

items.name: Obambo
items.lore: An unstable ghost alternating between calm and aggressive states.
items.hiddenAbility: Its state changes activity, speed, and hunt behavior.
weaknesses: Calm state is easier to observe
tips: Log several hunts to identify the alternating pattern
misconceptions: The Twins can also produce inconsistent speeds

items.name: Oni
items.lore: A highly visible and active ghost strengthened by nearby people.
items.hiddenAbility: Drains extra sanity during full-form events.
tips: Watch manifestation type and hunt blink visibility
misconceptions: High activity is supporting, not conclusive, evidence

items.name: Onryo
items.lore: A vengeful spirit whose hunt attempts interact with flame.
items.hiddenAbility: Attempts to hunt after every third flame blowout.
weaknesses: Nearby flames block hunts like crucifixes
tips: Run a controlled three-flame test away from crucifixes
misconceptions: Random candle blowouts are not enough

items.name: Phantom
items.lore: A ghost that weakens the mind of anyone who looks at it.
items.hiddenAbility: Travels to a random player and leaves EMF.
tips: Take a ghost photo during an event
misconceptions: A blank photo must coincide with an actual ghost event

items.name: Poltergeist
items.lore: A noisy ghost with exceptional control over nearby objects.
items.hiddenAbility: Can throw multiple objects simultaneously and drain sanity.
tips: Build an object pile and observe it from safety
misconceptions: A single strong throw is not unique

items.name: Raiju
items.lore: An electrical spirit that feeds on active equipment.
items.hiddenAbility: Disrupts electronics from farther away during hunts.
tips: Test speed with a controlled pile of active equipment
misconceptions: Any electronic interference is normal during hunts

items.name: Revenant
items.lore: A violent ghost that accelerates dramatically after detecting prey.
items.hiddenAbility: Moves very slowly while searching.
items.movementSpeed: Very slow without a target; extremely fast after detection.
weaknesses: Very slow when nobody is detected
tips: Listen from hiding before allowing a controlled detection
misconceptions: Line-of-sight acceleration on normal ghosts is more gradual

items.name: Shade
items.lore: A shy ghost that avoids activity around groups.
items.hiddenAbility: Cannot hunt while a player is in the same room.
tips: Compare activity with the room occupied and empty
misconceptions: Low activity alone may be ordinary randomness

items.name: Spirit
items.lore: A common ghost without an overt special ability.
items.hiddenAbility: Incense prevents hunts for longer than normal.
tips: Time the next hunt attempt after incense
misconceptions: Spirit is not behaviorless; its incense timing is diagnostic

items.name: Thaye
items.lore: An aging ghost that weakens as investigators remain nearby.
items.hiddenAbility: Ages near players, lowering activity, speed, and hunt threshold.
items.movementSpeed: Fast when young; slow when old.
tips: Compare early and late hunt speed and Ouija age
misconceptions: Time alone does not age it; players must be nearby

items.name: The Mimic
items.lore: An unpredictable ghost that copies the abilities of other types.
items.hiddenAbility: Changes the ghost behavior it mimics over time.
tips: Treat four-evidence combinations and changing tells as high-value clues
misconceptions: Its orbs are visible even on zero-evidence settings

items.name: The Twins
items.lore: A paired presence capable of interacting in two areas in quick succession.
items.hiddenAbility: Uses two interaction ranges and two hunt speed profiles.
items.movementSpeed: Slightly slower or faster than normal depending on the twin.
tips: Compare multiple hunts rather than one interaction
misconceptions: The activity-monitor twinteraction is not definitive

items.name: Wraith
items.lore: A floating ghost that refuses to disturb salt.
items.hiddenAbility: Can teleport to a player and leave EMF at their feet.
tips: Place salt directly in its path and verify pathing
misconceptions: Not seeing UV footprints after salt is not the test; the salt itself remains untouched

items.name: Yokai
items.lore: A ghost aggravated by nearby human voices.
items.hiddenAbility: Has a very short hearing and electronics detection range during hunts.
tips: Test voice detection from a controlled distance
misconceptions: Voice recognition errors are not a Yokai tell

items.name: Yurei
items.lore: A ghost with a powerful effect on sanity and doors.
items.hiddenAbility: Can sharply close a door and drain nearby sanity.
weaknesses: Incense traps it in its room temporarily
tips: Watch for a full door close paired with sanity loss
misconceptions: Ordinary door touches are common to all ghosts
